name: MasonryLayoutGroup
src_typeComment: Pinterest-style variable-height grid: each child keeps its OWN height, packed into whichever column is currently shortest — unlike GridLayoutGroup's uniform cell size. Deliberately a plain MonoBehaviour with an explicit Rebuild() call rather than a full ILayoutGroup/LayoutGroup subclass (which would auto-rebuild on every RectTransform change like Unity's built-in layout groups do) — implementing that integration correctly needs more Unity layout-system plumbing than this tool's value justified; call Rebuild() yourself after adding/removing/resizing children (Start() calls it once automatically).

src_members.name: Rebuild
src_members.comment: Re-packs every active child into the shortest-so-far column, top-left anchored, uniform width (columnWidth) but each child's OWN height left untouched — that per-child height variance is the entire point of a masonry layout. Resizes this container's own height to fit the tallest column.
